items.title: Enhance Security by Fixing DRF Router Issues in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical security issue where action-only viewsets were inadvertently exposing anonymous CRUD operations due to improper router configurations. By changing the inheritance from ModelViewSet to GenericViewSet, we ensure that only authorized actions are accessible, and new tests have been added to enforce this contract. The changes improve the overall security posture of the API endpoints.

items.title: Enhance Site Branding and Support Features in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new 'Branding and Support' tab, allowing site owners to customize their branding elements such as company name, copyright, and customer support channels. It also connects the customer support popover to the site's branding settings, ensuring that only the owner's channels are displayed. Additionally, the footer now correctly shows the owner's ICP filing number and copyright, enhancing compliance and user experience.

items.title: Enable Custom ICP Filing for Sub-sites in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update allows sub-sites to declare their own ICP filing numbers, ensuring compliance with regulations in mainland China. A new `icp` key has been added to the `branding` whitelist, allowing site owners to display their unique filing numbers in the footer. Additionally, the `test_site_branding.py` has been integrated into the CI pipeline, enhancing testing coverage for branding functionalities.

items.title: Enhance White-Labeling: Prevent Internal Links in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a mechanism to ensure that white-label sites do not display links pointing to Ace Data Cloud's own resources. Key changes include the implementation of a centralized check to hide specific links and branding elements that could mislead users about ownership. The adjustments enhance the integrity of reseller sites by preventing any direct references to Ace Data Cloud's platforms.

items.title: Revamp Site Detail Page with Underline Tabs in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: The site detail page has transitioned from a heavy `el-radio-group` button layout to a sleek Element Plus underline tab navigation. Each tab now serves purely as a navigation tool, with content displayed below to enhance performance and maintain a clean interface. This change improves user experience by allowing seamless tab sharing and navigation without cluttering the back stack.

items.title: Fix domain tab refresh issue and enhance DNS guidance in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical issue where the Domains tab would display blank upon refresh, failing to provide necessary DNS configuration instructions. Key changes include enhancing the backend to ensure DNS guidance is consistently available, improving the UI styling for better readability, and implementing safeguards against missing IDs in the binding process. These improvements enhance user experience and ensure reliable domain setup instructions.

items.title: Aligning White-Label Index Status with Main Branch in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses discrepancies between the white-label index status and the actual state on the main branch. Key corrections include the closure of item 34, which was incorrectly marked as pending review, and several other items that have now been accurately reflected as merged or closed. Additionally, a new section has been added to track ongoing experience gaps revealed after the recent deployment.

items.title: Fix Domains tab to show DNS instructions consistently in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves the issue where the Domains tab would appear blank after refreshing, failing to display DNS instructions. By elevating `dns_instructions` to a serializer field, it ensures that this information is consistently rendered across all read paths. Additionally, the CNAME target now dynamically resolves from the bound site, improving user experience and reducing the need for manual updates.

items.title: Fix language reset issue on refresh in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses a critical bug where the interface language reverted to English after a page refresh, despite user selection. The fix involves reading the LOCALE cookie directly during startup to ensure the user's language preference is maintained. Additionally, regression tests have been added to cover various scenarios, ensuring the functionality remains intact.

items.title: Update Python Dependencies for Enhanced Performance in x402 🚀
items.summary: This PR updates several key Python dependencies, including `x402` from version 2.16.0 to 2.17.0, `tencentcloud-sdk-python` from 3.1.140 to 3.1.145, and `uvicorn` from 0.51.0 to 0.52.0. These updates bring performance improvements and new features, ensuring better compatibility and functionality within the x402 ecosystem.

items.title: Upgrade artifact upload action to version 7 in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the actions/upload-artifact from version 4 to 7, introducing support for direct file uploads and upgrading the module to ESM. Key modifications were made in the CI and extension release workflows to utilize the new version. This change enhances the artifact upload process and ensures compatibility with the latest Node.js features.

items.title: Fix chat components to render correctly in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update resolves a critical issue where the action confirmation card and TikTok publish forms were rendering without any interactive elements. By registering the necessary Element Plus components, all chat cards now display the appropriate inputs, selects, checkboxes, and buttons. A new test has been added to prevent similar issues in the future.

items.title: Enhance Chat Card Styles and Functionality in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update improves the action confirmation card by removing a duplicate tool row and aligning its style with the connector consent card. Key changes include updated corner radii, shadows, and animations for a more cohesive look. Additionally, the TikTok card is now rendered as read-only after confirmation, preventing further edits.
